measurement_note: Every variant redirects only the target symbol(s) inside the unmodified Proven-17 bend5k_o2 -O2 ELF .o (same runtime-agy.o, same +RTS --threads 1 --gpu off -RTS) via ELF64 SHT_SYMTAB SHN_UNDEF redirection to the patch object. All timings are 5-run medians on CPU 4 with exact stdout checksums verified bit-identical against baseline, gcc-10 -O2, and gcc-10 -O3 -march=native.

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/raytrace/main.bend (scaled ROWS=7, WIDTH=6000; 1/32nd of full ROWS=12, exact horizontal ray distribution)
probes.primary_mechanism: Proven-17 emits $v8r.nearest (87 insns) and $v8r.nearest.t (83 insns), beating gcc-10 -O2 (0.974x), but loses to gcc-10 -O3 -march=native (1.549x; full 18.47s vs 11.77s) because: (1) $direct.nearest heap-allocates a Hit{ms, t, i} ADT node on every ray and $direct.trace unpacks/frees it with p111_rt_take fallback; (2) $direct.nearest / $direct.nearest.t / $direct.trace are called out-of-line with 7 stack-pushed args and vzeroupper on every bounce; (3) $direct.colf executes a 14-deep binary tree recursion and calls p111_rt_op for F32.to_u32 on every pixel; (4) rays are traced 1-at-a-time instead of exploiting the 4-subray-per-pixel or 8-ray AVX1 packet coherence.

variants.name: a_inline_v8r_unboxed_hit_in_subray
variants.note: ALREADY BEATS gcc-10 -O3 -march=native BY 1.23x (0.814x O3-native, 1.904x speedup vs Proven-17; projects full ROWS=12 from 18.47s down to ~9.70s vs 11.77s O3-native)! Leaves $direct.colf and $direct.rowf 100% untouched. Eliminates Hit heap boxing (ret2), inlines $v8r.nearest/$v8r.nearest.t into $direct.trace with SIMD horizontal min for nearest.t, and eliminates call/vzeroupper overhead per bounce.

variants.name: b_plus_flat_colf_inline_f2u_4ray_sse_packet
variants.note: 3.42x FASTER THAN gcc-10 -O3 -march=native (0.292x O3-native, 5.301x speedup; projects full ROWS=12 down to ~3.48s vs 11.77s O3-native)! Flattens colf recursion, inlines F32.to_u32 (0 p111_rt_op), and traces all 4 subrays of each 2x2 supersampled pixel simultaneously in 4-wide SSE4.1 (__m128 packet with active-lane masking).

variants.name: c_8ray_avx1_packet_2pixels
variants.note: 4.72x FASTER THAN gcc-10 -O3 -march=native (0.212x O3-native, 7.308x speedup; projects full ROWS=12 down to ~2.53s vs 11.77s O3-native)! Traces 8 coherent rays simultaneously in 8-wide AVX1 (__m256 = 2 adjacent pixels x 4 subrays) with vblendvps/vmovmskps active-lane early-out across all 9 spheres.

probes.general_compiler_pass: Tier 1 (already <1.0x vs gcc-10 -O3 -march=native): extend ret2/ret3 unboxed small-ADT return to 3-word Hit{ms,t,i} + inline $v8r.<fn> into self-TCO callers + SIMD horizontal-min + inline F32.to_u32. Tier 2 (4.7x faster than O3-native): outer-loop 4-wide/8-wide coherent FP task vectorization (predicated $v8 SIMD over independent subray/pixel calls, extending the existing nbody $v8 pass).
probes.verdict: STRONG GO (1.90x -> 0.814x O3-native from Tier 1 inlining + unboxed Hit alone; 7.31x -> 0.212x O3-native with 8-ray AVX1 packet!)
probes.estimated_loc: ~90 LOC for Tier 1 (unboxed 3-word Hit return + inline $v8r into caller + inline F32.to_u32); ~140 LOC for Tier 2 (predicated 8-wide outer-loop $v8 SIMD)

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/terrain/main.bend (scaled SIZE=11, EPASS=5; 2,048 tiles x 64x64 fill + 5 Gauss-Seidel erode sweeps + 64-bin hist)
probes.primary_mechanism: gcc-10 -O3 -march=native auto-vectorizes tile_fill (69 vec ops), dropping C from 253.52 ms (-O2) to 195.04 ms (-O3 -march=native; full 8.02s -> 6.18s). Meanwhile bend5k operates on heap-allocated 64-bit Array<U32> (32 KB = L1D thrash), runs scalar fill, and $direct.erode carries 113 spills, 32 jcc/0 cmov edge clamps, and 24 mask `and`s.

variants.name: a_stack_u32_4096_nowrap_cmov_erode
variants.note: Beats gcc-10 -O2 (0.917x) via non-escaping stack u32[4096] + u32[64] (16 KB L1D-resident, 0 heap alloc, 0 mask `and`) + branchless cmov erode, but stays 1.192x vs gcc-10 -O3 -march=native because fill is still scalar.

variants.name: b_plus_interior_unclamped_gauss_seidel_erode
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O3 -march=native EVEN WITH SCALAR FILL (0.914x O3-native, 0.703x O2, 2.359x speedup; projects full SIZE=16 from 13.44s down to ~5.70s vs 6.18s O3-native)! Boundary-splitting x=0,63 from unclamped interior x=1..62 + Gauss-Seidel sliding-window scalar promotion (hl=nv, hc=hr -> 3 loads/cell instead of 5).

variants.name: c_plus_sse41_4wide_fill
variants.note: CRUSHES gcc-10 -O3 -march=native BY 1.40x (0.714x O3-native, 0.549x O2, 3.021x speedup; projects full SIZE=16 down to ~4.45s vs 6.18s O3-native)! Adding 4-wide SSE4.1 (pmulld/pslld/psrld/pxor) counted U32 fill vectorization on top of stack u32[4096] + unclamped Gauss-Seidel erode.

probes.general_compiler_pass: Non-escaping fixed-size local Array<U32> stack-promotion (u32[N] on stack; shared with bfs, editdist, local-fold) + boundary-split unclamped interior with loop-carried sliding-window scalar promotion (shared with editdist) + 4-wide SSE4.1 counted U32 array-fill vectorization (shared with histogram, bfs).
probes.verdict: STRONG GO (2.36x -> 0.914x O3-native with stack u32[4096] + unclamped Gauss-Seidel erode alone; 3.02x -> 0.714x O3-native with 4-wide SSE4.1 fill!)
probes.estimated_loc: ~110 LOC (shared across terrain, local-fold, bfs, editdist, histogram)

wave18_o3_native_summary.raytrace_to_beat_o3_native: Inline $v8r.nearest/$v8r.nearest.t + unbox 3-word Hit (ret3) -> 0.814x vs gcc-10 -O3 -march=native (~9.70s vs 11.77s); 8-ray AVX1 packet -> 0.212x (~2.53s vs 11.77s).
wave18_o3_native_summary.terrain_to_beat_o3_native: Stack u32[4096] + unclamped interior Gauss-Seidel scalar promotion -> 0.914x vs gcc-10 -O3 -march=native (~5.70s vs 6.18s); + 4-wide SSE4.1 fill -> 0.714x (~4.45s vs 6.18s).
